Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP pressure, isolation, defensive/reactive utilities, assists, and target clarity.
Description: A local PvP HUD integrating pressure and CC-protection cues, an urgent isolation warning, native-HUD resource auras, default-off Ninja and Scholar action helpers, a default-off passive Smart Bard Paean target redirect, fail-closed macro assistance, defensive/reactive utilities with optional Guardian team communication, team-visible focus marking, and target highlights.
Changelog: Adds a separate default-off Smart Bard Paean target option for exact Crystalline Conflict. It may redirect only an already incoming manual or downstream Turbo The Warden's Paean 29400 call to an exact reachable non-self party ally without the live Paean ward and with known incoming pressure of at least three, ranking pressure before exact HP and stable identity. An incomplete or ambiguous party view, or no known eligible ally, leaves the original call vanilla. After a redirect is frozen, final identity, action metadata, life, HP, ward, reachability, or pressure drift suppresses that one call with no original-target fallback, alternate, replay, retry, action substitution, or selected-target mutation. This passive transform has no cooldown/readiness gate. Also hardens Ninja Seiton with a final frozen-target HP read that cancels at exactly 50% or higher, and fixes Guardian Bind pairs when an unused native marker slot reports 0xE0000000 instead of zero without weakening exact ownership checks. Schema 22 keeps Smart Paean off for new, upgraded, and reset settings; existing Ally Rescue and Aquaveil behavior remains unchanged.
